svg.text: RASPBERRY PI 5 · DAC+ · CHORUS I / II
A4 · PRINT AT 100% / ACTUAL SIZE · NO SCALING
Case: KKSB case for Raspberry Pi 5 + DAC+/DAC Pro. Measure your lid/sides before cutting — sizes are estimates (see README).
SCALE CHECK: this bar must measure exactly 50 mm
Dashed line = cut line (1 mm black bleed outside).
Glossy/matte vinyl sticker paper, laser or inkjet. Not affiliated with Roland.
